name: list_task_packs
title: List task packs
description: List the task packs you may use, with the inputs, parameters and requirements of each.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the call arguments; for submit_result, into the submission

products.description: every name of the product line the pack is bound to; all of them name one line

accepts.description: media types, or external object types written system:type

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of the value, as the pack declares it; absent when the pack declares none

layers.description: the judgment layers this requirement is judged on; other layers are not applicable

observation.description: The declared P07 observation contract for the dynamic layer

rules.description: locked rule@version identities that judge this requirement

run_interpreters.description: ledger-permitted interpreters for inline runtime tables; empty when disabled

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file
description: Upload a local file as a source artifact. Returns a reference to use as a run input. Identical bytes give the same reference.

file_path.description: The file to upload. Give the local path; the client sends the file bytes.

media_type.description: Media type if known, for example text/markdown

path.description: JSON Pointer into the call arguments; for submit_result, into the submission

reference.description: src:<sha256> of the stored bytes, to use as a run input; only when accepted

structure.description: Summary from the parser that recognised the file

name: start_run
title: Start a run
description: Freeze the work for a task pack: requirements, items, locked knowledge version and the pack procedure. Inputs are references from upload_file or external object identities.

pack.description: Pack id from list_task_packs, optionally followed by @version

product.description: Product name; every name of a product line is accepted

build.description: Exact build name; chosen by the pack rule when omitted

reference.description: reference returned by upload_file, or any reference the caller may read

external.description: external object identity system:type:id[@revision], of a type the input slot accepts

reference.description: reference returned by upload_file, or any reference the caller may read

external.description: external object identity system:type:id[@revision], of a type the input slot accepts

inputs.description: Input slot name to reference or external object

parameters.description: The parameters the pack declares, as one object by name, for example {"<name>": <value>}; list_task_packs lists every pack parameter with its name, description and schema

submission_due.description: Requested absolute submission deadline; the service binds its actual finite policy before writing the run

client_key.description: Client chosen key; repeating it within its time window returns the same run

path.description: JSON Pointer into the call arguments; for submit_result, into the submission

criterion.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

reference.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

product.description: product line the run is bound to

pointer.description: where the claim comes from: a JSON Pointer into the submission, or into the checked subject

reason.description: why the verdict is unknown: check error, timeout, missing input (V01 R[2])

rank.description: ranking level from the closed set the pack declares; for sorting and display only (V02)

collected_at.description: time bound: when the observation the claim rests on was collected; it holds only for that moment (A05)

items.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

grounds.description: references the claim rests on; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address (B01 R[5])

resolutions.description: each exact value of the statement with what it resolved to (W08, T04 R[1])

pointer.description: where the value stands, as a JSON Pointer into the submission

text.description: the exact value or quotation as the model wrote it

items.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

references.description: what it resolved to: one or more when resolved, the candidates when ambiguous, none when unresolved

bound.description: digests the claim depends on; a change in any of them voids it

target_basis.description: how product, version and build were fixed: one claim each; provenance declared when the caller gave the value, projected when the pack rule chose it, observed when a target echoed it; grounds cite what the choice read

unversioned_root.description: product-wide knowledge root locked for this run

root.description: knowledge root locked for this run

coverage.description: Observed coverage of the external read frozen with these bytes; absent on legacy bindings

reference.description: the bound bytes or fragment; read it with get_nodes

slot.description: input slot the source came in through

external.description: external object identity with the revision the Hub read

label.description: display name, for example the title of a linked record

sources.description: every source bound to the run besides the knowledge root: inputs and the expected sources the pack bound

layers.description: the judgment layers this requirement is judged on; other layers are not applicable

observation.description: The declared P07 observation contract for the dynamic layer

rules.description: locked rule@version identities that judge this requirement

run_interpreters.description: ledger-permitted interpreters for inline runtime tables; empty when disabled

summary.description: one short line the model reads about the item (from the pack projection); the text of a tool result is limited, so a long list of items is shown as id, label and summary only

location.description: where the item sits in the judged source

digest.description: item fingerprint the Hub computes from the canonical fields; unchanged across runs means the item can be carried over

reuse.description: set by the Hub when the predecessor run has an unchanged item: the Hub record reference to give back in the submission to carry it over

slots.description: the slot schema to fill for each item; absent when the pack declares no slots

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of the slot record of one item, from the pack file slots.schema.json, with the closed sets the pack declares (finding codes, ranks, slot kinds)

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pack file the schema comes from

session.description: client session id observed from the request header

submission_due.description: Absolute submission deadline; absent only on historical runs, never inferred by readers

reference.description: the validation_result record of the run; read it with get_nodes and this reference

unknown.description: items with at least one layer terminal that is unknown: unchecked, no verdict or not run (V03 R[4])

pending_unknown.description: Additional count, not a partition: items whose layers retain unresolved unknown gaps beside their primary terminal

name: get_nodes
title: Read knowledge nodes
description: Read subtrees of the knowledge tree locked by a run, or the content a reference points at.

run.description: Use the knowledge root locked by this run

root.description: Knowledge root digest; defaults to the run root

paths.description: Subtrees to read: node paths copied verbatim from get_nodes or from a tree reference, for example / or /commands/show

items.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

reference.description: Read the content a reference points at instead of a subtree

path.description: JSON Pointer into the call arguments; for submit_result, into the submission

root.description: Knowledge root the nodes belong to

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

reference.description: Tree address of the node, tree:<root><path>; cite it verbatim as a ground

level.description: Position label of the node, computed from the tree height

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

reference.description: Tree address of the node pinned to this entry, tree:<root><path>@<entry>; cite it verbatim as a ground

data.description: Machine-readable content of the entry, for example the signatures and typed parameters of a catalog leaf

contributions.description: A bounded page of contributions beside the tree; continue with next; not part of the root digest

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

model.description: client-declared integration model/configuration, not an evidence grade

inherited.description: Inherited field codes only; source positions belong to composition provenance

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

inherited.description: Inherited field codes only; source positions belong to composition provenance

view_id.description: Exact external view id for composition-pinned continuation

path.description: Knowledge tree path in canonical text, as the Hub writes it (percent escapes kept verbatim); / is the root

read_tier.description: model_readable: text is given; function_bytes_only: only sha256 and structure; retain_only: neither

structure.description: Summary from the parser, when the bytes are for functions only

name: resolve_reference
title: Resolve a value to a reference
description: Preview how an exact value or quotation resolves against the sources bound to a run. The result is a preview and not evidence.

text.description: The exact value or quotation to resolve, copied verbatim

expect.description: What it should resolve to, for example command or quotation

path.description: JSON Pointer into the call arguments; for submit_result, into the submission

resolution.description: How the value resolves; absent on a protocol error

reference.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

references.description: Possible referents, citable as grounds; empty on a protocol error

name: submit_result
title: Submit results
description: Submit your results item by item. The Hub validates them and returns the receipt, partitions and the terminal state of every requirement. Repeating a submission returns the current result.

model.description: model name and exact configuration as the client declares it

slots.description: slot record, validated against the pack slot schema (RunSummary.slots)

context.description: digest of the context the model used for this item, so unchanged items can be reused

reuse.description: instead of slots: the Hub record reference start_run offered for this item, to carry the predecessor fragment over; the Hub checks that the item and the cited content are unchanged and reruns the checks

missing.description: Explicit remaining work; otherwise the Hub derives the unfinished item from its frozen projection

exit.description: Optional fully bound intent; the Hub binds the actual request and named recipient

identity.description: External account identity bound by the referenced mapping

due.description: Absolute next-execution time or the named request deadline; never inferred when reading history

reason.description: why the item is skipped (W07 F[2])

items.description: reference a claim rests on: src, tree or rec; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

grounds.description: a fact needs at least one reference; a knowledge entry is cited by its tree address

premises.description: earlier cross_item entries of this submission that this judgment rests on, for example /cross_item/0

result.description: The validation result (validation@1) when the submission was validated against a run you may use; absent on a protocol error such as an unknown or unavailable run. A repeated submission returns the stored result, whose trace is that of the call that produced it

contributions.description: Dedicated contribution run receipt; ordinary submissions never write the knowledge layer

submission.description: Digest of the received user submission; with system_input, digest of that action detail.input instead; legacy production uses the run record digest

system_input.description: System-delivery input action; detail.input contains the exact canonical input whose digest is submission; never a user receipt

errors.description: every code that kept the submission from being accepted, item-level refutations with their fixes and rounds left, and items the submission did not cover
